verdict.rationale: Column exposes some building blocks — book-transfer holds (docs-14), per-account-number permissions/limits confirmed by a community user (comm-7), and custom roles for access control (docs-19) — but there is no documentation of configurable transaction/velocity limits per account or program, no account-freeze mechanism, and no documented reinstatement path for held/frozen accounts. missing for 10: velocity/transaction limit configuration APIs, explicit account freeze capability, documented reinstatement/appeal workflow, program-level (vs. per-account) risk control scoping.
